title: Free internal condensed modules and the free-forgetful adjunction
statement: Fix the small coherent profinite site $J$ of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], regarded as a commutative monoid object of the tensor category of abelian sheaves, and let $\operatorname{Mod}_R$ be its category of internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Define the free internal module functor $L_R:\operatorname{Sh}(J,\operatorname{Set})\to\operatorname{Mod}_R$ as the composite of the free abelian sheaf functor (apply the free abelian group functor and sheafify) and the free internal $R$-module functor. Define its adjunction with the forgetful functor $U_R$ to condensed sets by composing these two free-forgetful adjunctions. Thus $L_R(X)=R[X]$, its unit is the canonical generator map $X\to U_R(R[X])$, and a map of condensed sets is carried to the functorial map of free modules. In universe $u$, use profinite sets in $u$, sets and abelian groups in $u+1$, and internal modules in $u+2$.
